body:
PR-2906 round 3 pushed at 28a2d5a0bd1e04493dc21d4635998aa0c20172b5 (branch claude/task-2325, rebased cleanly onto origin/main via `aida ship TASK-2325 --no-merge`, review story STORY-1924 re-queued).

All seven items from the TASK-2325 rework brief addressed and verified:
1. `disk_emergency.rs::scratch_at_hard_ceiling` / `run_emergency_probed`: scratch deletes now push `Candidate { reason: Reason::AgentScratch }` into `outcome.deleted` and the single terminal `LedgerRow::Run` summary is emitted AFTER the scratch tier completes (with post-scratch `deleted`, `freed_bytes`, `used_pct_after`, and `stopped`). Scratch-only recovery now triggers `emergency_notice` and updates `last_reclaim()`.
2. `scratch_reclaim.rs::plan_tmp` & `plan_build_caches`: filter symlinks (`file_type().is_symlink()`) at top level, inside project-slug dirs, and for build-cache paths before aging/pricing; `aged()` also rejects symlinks via `symlink_metadata`. Static/dangling links no longer abort `--apply` mid-run; delete-site `check()` remains as race defense.
3. `scratch_reclaim.rs::apply` & `worktree_reclaim.rs`: honor `--target-pct` across scratch rows, probing before each deletion and recording `stopped_early`.
4. `worktree_gc_args.rs`: updated `Reclaim` help text to describe all scratch/cache roots and deletion scope accurately; regenerated `cli_help_snapshot.txt`.
5. `story_1916_disk_emergency_tests.rs`: added positive injected-survey test `task_2325_emergency_hard_ceiling_scratch_deletes_ledgers_stops_and_notifies` (verifies scratch deletion, `AgentScratch` ledger row, early stop below ceiling, 4-day `min_age.max(cfg.idle())` floor, `last_reclaim()`, and `emergency_notice()`), while keeping `task_2325_emergency_without_injected_roots_touches_no_scratch`.
6. `disk_emergency.rs`: `scratch_at_hard_ceiling` skips the scratch pass when `outcome.stopped == Stop::Refused`; covered by `task_2325_emergency_cache_refusal_skips_scratch_tier`.
7. `disk_emergency.rs::walk_cache` / `scratch_reclaim.rs::aged`: uses `symlink_metadata` (lstat) and skips nested symlinks so external trees neither inflate byte counts nor pin scratch age; covered by `task_2325_nested_symlink_to_external_tree_does_not_inflate_bytes_or_pin_age`.

Validation:
- `AIDA_CARGO_TIMEOUT=20m cargo test --profile agent -p aida-cli-lib task_2325` (6/6 passed)
- `scratch_reclaim` (12/12) and `disk_emergency` (32/32) unit suites passed
- `make check-ci-fast` (34/34 gates passed)
